lines.text: Si fuerit in undecimo, honoratus erit & diues & exaltatus.
lines.en: If it is in the eleventh, he will be honored and rich and exalted.

lines.text: Si fuerit in duodecimo, erit infortunatus & malæ uitæ.
lines.en: If it is in the twelfth, he will be unfortunate and of a bad life.

summary.headline: Lord of the Twelfth House
summary.text: Chapter XIX explains the effects of the lord of the twelfth house in each of the twelve places, including consequences for enemies, substance, siblings, father, children, servants, spouses, death, faith, princes, inheritance, and friends. Chapter XX begins a discussion of Saturn in its terms and of other planets in the nativity.
